question: what is this company worth, and what does the price already assume?

value_range.reading: Python computed no value range, and no enterprise value, equity value or value per share for any scenario. The calculator prints the reason under valuation.missing: "WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Under cost_of_capital.missing it prints: "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The inputs that did arrive are the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value|pct} and the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium.value|pct}. The beta, the market value of equity, the cost of equity, the weights and therefore the discount rate are all missing. The gap is the beta and the price, not the cost of debt, so nothing missing here is mine to supply as an override, and I give no value and no range. What can be read is what my drivers assume against the record. The base case starts from trailing revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.value}. Its year-one growth sits a little above the trailing four-quarter rate of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}, because acquisitions already closed add a full year of revenue. Its year-one GAAP operating margin sits below the trailing {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct}, because a full year of acquired-intangible amortization, replacement-award stock pay and integration cost falls inside it. By year ten the base case carries operating margin well above the best filed year, fiscal 2025 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}, and above the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. The base case therefore rests on margin expansion that the filed record points toward but has not yet shown.

Under market it prints: "no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The free-cash-flow yield cross-check needs the same price, and its price, enterprise value and equity yield are missing for the same reason. I supply no price of my own, and I do not say whether the price would sit above, inside or below a range that was never computed.

market_implied_growth.reading: No market-implied growth exists. The reverse DCF needs the discount rate and the price. Under implied_growth_beside_history the calculator prints: "no reverse DCF: WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The history it would have been read against is on record. Revenue grew {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2025, the slowest filed year, at a three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and a five-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. Trailing four-quarter growth is {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}, and the latest quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct} year over year, a figure that includes acquired revenue. My base year-one growth sits a little above the trailing and three-year rates and below the five-year rate. It fades to a terminal rate held below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value|pct}. My input holds no revenue guidance from the company. The results-of-operations current report filed 2026-06-02 is listed by item code only, with no body. MD&A explains growth rather than forecasting it: "Our growth reflects the increased adoption of our portfolio, which consists of product, subscriptions, and support, and our recent acquisitions". It also reserves discretion over the acquired share: "we may qualitatively or quantitatively disclose the impact of our acquisitions on revenue, costs, and expenses for the one year period subsequent to the acquisition date where such discussions would be meaningful". The organic rate, the most useful benchmark for any market-implied figure, is therefore not disclosed either.

most_sensitive.assumption: year-ten operating margin; its effect on value is not measured, because the sensitivity grid was not computed
most_sensitive.reading: Python produced no sensitivity grid and no scenario values, so no assumption's effect on value is measured here. The cause is the one printed under valuation.missing. What the drivers themselves show is where the scenarios disagree most against the record, and year-ten operating margin is the widest of them. The bear case ends only modestly above the best filed year, fiscal 2025 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}. The bull case ends at more than double that year, and the base case ends well above it. The record supports the direction, since operating margin rose from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2021 to the fiscal 2025 level. Against that, the trailing margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct} and the latest quarter's operating result of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter.value} show the acquisitions pulling the other way for now.

most_sensitive.assumption: year-one revenue growth; its effect on value is not measured, because the sensitivity grid was not computed
most_sensitive.reading: Year-one revenue growth is the other driver on which the scenarios spread widely against the record. The bear case starts below the three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and below fiscal 2025 growth of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct}. The base case starts a little above the trailing four-quarter rate of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}. The bull case starts above the five-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} but below the latest quarter's year-over-year growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct}. Python fades growth in a straight line to the terminal rate, so the year-one choice carries into every year of the forecast. How much this driver and the year-ten margin each move value cannot be said until a price series lets the discount rate be computed. The same holds for how they compare with the gap between the terminal rate and the discount rate.

accounting_adjustments.reading: No accounting adjustment moved value, because no value was computed, and none would have reached the calculator in any case. The accounting reader wrote one adjustment, a reduction against proceeds from sold receivables. It was dropped because the record has no row for that field. Quality-adjusted free cash flow shows no adjustment applied and none refused. As both analyses note, two inputs to the step from enterprise value to equity value are understated in the calculator, and they would need correcting before a per-share figure could be trusted. First, total debt reads {ratios.solvency.total_debt.value}, because the convertible notes assumed with CyberArk sit under concepts the calculator's debt groups do not read. Yet MD&A says that if the conversion condition is met and holders convert, "we would be obligated to settle the $1.1 billion principal amount of the 2030 Notes" in cash. Second, the operating lease liability is the fiscal 2025 year-end figure of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}, which the calculator itself flags as smaller than the current non-current balance. Separately, the tax rate is held at {tax_rate.value|pct} while the trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, so a computed DCF would tax operating income more lightly than the company's recent record.

summary_ko.value_range: 가격 시계열이 주어지지 않아 베타와 자기자본비용, 가중평균자본비용을 구하지 못했고, 그래서 가치 범위와 시나리오별 기업가치·자기자본가치·주당가치는 계산되지 않았습니다. 확보된 입력은 무위험수익률 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value|pct}와 주식위험프리미엄 {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium.value|pct}뿐이며, 기본 시나리오는 직전 회계연도 영업이익률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}을 크게 웃도는 장기 이익률을 가정합니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 계산 파일에 기준일 주가가 없고 가치 범위도 없으므로, 주가가 범위의 어디에 놓이는지는 읽을 수 없습니다. 같은 이유로 잉여현금흐름 수익률도 계산되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF가 계산되지 않아 시장 가격이 가정하는 성장률은 나오지 않았습니다. 비교할 과거 기록은 직전 세 회계연도 연평균 매출 성장률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}와 최근 연간 합산 매출 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}이며, 회사는 입력 자료에서 매출 가이던스나 유기적 성장률을 제시하지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 어떤 가정이 가치를 가장 크게 움직이는지는 측정되지 않았습니다. 시나리오 사이 차이가 가장 큰 가정은 예측 마지막 해의 영업이익률과 첫해 매출 성장률로, 각각 직전 회계연도 영업이익률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}와 최근 연간 합산 매출 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}를 기준으로 넓게 벌어져 있습니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 가치가 계산되지 않았으므로 회계 조정이 가치를 움직인 금액은 없고, 품질조정 잉여현금흐름에도 적용된 조정이 없습니다. 다만 계산 파일의 총차입금 {ratios.solvency.total_debt.value}에는 CyberArk 인수로 넘겨받은 전환사채가 빠져 있고 리스부채도 직전 회계연도 말 수치여서, 나중에 가치를 계산하면 주당가치가 실제보다 높게 나올 수 있습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
